rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that something is really or genuinely the case.

example.english: The egg tarts at this shop are truly delicious.
example.traditional: 呢間舖嘅蛋撻真係好食。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 daan6 taat1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when truly means very or extremely.
Use this when explicitly introducing a candid or truthful statement, rather than simply intensifying it.

example.english: Honestly, I truly don't want to go.
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for accurately or faithfully reporting facts, especially in written or formal contexts.

example.english: This report truly reflects the facts.
example.traditional: 呢份報告如實反映事實。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jyu4 sat6 faan2 jing2 si6 sat6
